title: More pre-registered claim tests
headline: 15 unsigned nanopub evidence records drafted for the 14 completed claim tests (6 supported, 5 refuted, 3 partially supported, 1 not-tested reading), all passing np check; 12 new pre-registered tests this hack (5 supported, 3 refuted, 2 mixed, 2 blocked on Dryad), 16 tests on the site in all with checksummed public data.
blockers: Dryad (datadryad.org) blocks scripted downloads with a proof-of-work challenge; two pre-registered tests (hamilton-lmc, maynardsmith-war-of-attrition) stay inconclusive until someone downloads 3 small files in a browser into their data/ folders.

The published Project Delphi evidence-item template still uses the legacy probknow namespace, so the 15 drafts declare no assertion template (decision logged in claim-tests/nanopubs/DECISIONS.md); the 2.0 template needs publishing by the ontology maintainer.

needs.ask: Download DryadData.xlsx (doi:10.5061/dryad.15nj0) into claim-tests/math-bio-theorems/hamilton-lmc/data/ and fight.csv + README.md (doi:10.5061/dryad.bg79cnpjg) into claim-tests/math-bio-theorems/maynardsmith-war-of-attrition/data/, then tell me; fetch.py records the checksums and the pre-registered analysis runs unchanged.

Name the ORCID key owner who approves signing: the 15 evidence drafts in claim-tests/nanopubs/unsigned/ carry no human ORCID until that person approves; test registry first, production only on explicit approval.
Approve one branch for the whole tree so the local commits on main (claim-tests/ and dashboard/public/t/claims/) can be pushed; nothing is pushed until then, per the hub.
